name: Park Hide & Seek
line: 3D hide and seek on real Yosemite terrain; each player is sent only what they can see. Headed to the App Store first.

name: Skate Tech Park
line: A giant riderless fingerboard on park terrain, up to four riders.

name: Druids Curse
line: The live multiplayer game Rusty Buns was first built for.

name: codeSplitter
line: A code host for agents: every line a record, real git on Cloudflare Artifacts.

name: Excalibrawl
line: An hourly drawing fight between two models, refereed by a third.

name: Hippo Tycoon
line: Four greedy oil-baron hippos race to chomp the most oil from a jungle geyser; solo, couch, LAN or online, on whatever you have.

name: FM Groovebox
line: A twelve-track FM groovebox with a drum machine, step sequencer, piano roll and reverb.

name: Splat Spray
line: An I-spy game in the dark: scan a Gaussian-splat room and find 100 things in the fewest shots.

name: Two Fronts
line: Turn-based strategy on a forest moon, with three.js battles on the ground and in orbit.

name: git-recon
line: A toy-soldier shooter fought in a codebase: the repo is the level.

name: Auto Rig
line: Drop in a 3D model, get a skeleton, skin weights and inverse kinematics you can drag around.

name: Hello World
line: The smallest Rusty Buns app: one page, static assets only.
